preconditions.expression: all(len(votes[i]) == len(votes[0]) for i in range(len(votes)))
preconditions.description: All vote strings have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() for vote in votes for c in vote)
preconditions.description: All characters in votes are uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(vote)) == len(vote) for vote in votes)
preconditions.description: All characters in each vote string are unique.
All teams in votes[0] appear in every other vote string.

postconditions.description: The output string contains exactly the unique teams from the first vote.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] != return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i+1, len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: All teams in the output string are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in votes[0] for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: All teams in the output string are from the input votes.

postconditions.expression: all(ord(return_value[i]) < ord(return_value[j]) or (ord(return_value[i]) == ord(return_value[j]) and i < j) for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i+1, len(return_value)) if (all(return_value[i] != votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[i] == votes[k][q] and return_value[j] == votes[k][r] and q < r) and (all(return_value[j] != votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[j] == votes[k][q] and return_value[i] == votes[k][r] and q < r)) or (all(return_value[i] == votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[i] == votes[k][q] and return_value[j] == votes[k][r] and q < r) and (all(return_value[j] == votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[j] == votes[k][q] and return_value[i] == votes[k][r] and q < r))))
postconditions.description: Teams are ordered by their position in votes, where a team with a higher position in more votes comes first. If tied, the team with the higher position in the next position comes first, and so on. If still tied, teams are ordered alphabetically.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == return_value[j] or (all(return_value[i] != votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[i] == votes[k][q] and return_value[j] == votes[k][r] and q < r) or (all(return_value[j] != votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[j] == votes[k][q] and return_value[i] == votes[k][r] and q < r)) or (all(return_value[i] == votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[i] == votes[k][q] and return_value[j] == votes[k][r] and q < r) and (all(return_value[j] == votes[k][p] for k in range(len(votes)) for p in range(len(votes[k])) if return_value[j] == votes[k][q] and return_value[i] == votes[k][r] and q < r)) or ord(return_value[i]) < ord(return_value[j])) for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i+1, len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The output string is a valid ranking of teams according to the tie-breaking rules: position votes, then alphabetical order.
